## Packages

```{r packages}
CRANpackages <- c("tidyverse", "ggplot2", "ggpubr", 
                  "ggstats","BiocManager","viridis",
                  "gghighlight", "ggrepel","pheatmap","writexl")
biocPackages <- c("apeglm", "DESeq2","limma", "biomaRt","fgsea","WGCNA")

for(i in CRANpackages){
  if(!(i %in% rownames(installed.packages()))){
    install.packages(pkgs = i)
  }
  library(package = i, character.only = T, quietly = T)
  rm(i)
}

for(i in biocPackages){
  if(!(i %in% rownames(installed.packages()))){
    BiocManager::install(pkgs = i, ask = F)
  }
  library(package = i, character.only = T, quietly = T)
  rm(i)
}

rm(CRANpackages,biocPackages)

```

## Clean pathway names
```{r pathNames}

# Hallmark 
names(pathways.hallmark) <- gsub("HALLMARK_",replacement = "", x = names(pathways.hallmark))
names(pathways.hallmark) <- gsub("_", replacement = " ", x = names(pathways.hallmark))
names(pathways.hallmark) <- str_to_title(names(pathways.hallmark))

#Reactome
names(pathways.reactome) <- gsub("REACTOME_",replacement = "", x = names(pathways.reactome))
names(pathways.reactome) <- gsub("_", replacement = " ", x = names(pathways.reactome))
names(pathways.reactome) <- str_to_title(names(pathways.reactome))

#GO
names(pathways.go) <- gsub("GOBP_",replacement = "", x = names(pathways.go))
names(pathways.go) <- gsub("_", replacement = " ", x = names(pathways.go))
names(pathways.go) <- str_to_title(names(pathways.go))

#Immune
names(pathways.immune) <- gsub("CUI_",replacement = "", x = names(pathways.immune))
names(pathways.immune) <- gsub("_", replacement = " ", x = names(pathways.immune))
names(pathways.immune) <- str_to_title(names(pathways.immune))


```

## GSEA for all treatments
Using [FGSEA](https://stephenturner.github.io/deseq-to-fgsea/) package.

```{r LPSgsea}
setwd("/Users/irika/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-JohnsHopkins/WongLing/Others/250601_GL/2025_GL_RatSeq/")
gsea <- function(dds_df, pathways.hallmark,pathways.reactome,pathways.go,pathways.immune){
  # Add test statistic & remove duplicates by averaging
  dds_df <- dds_df %>% mutate(stat = log2FoldChange/lfcSE) %>% 
    dplyr::select(external_gene_name, stat) %>% 
    na.omit() %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(external_gene_name) %>% 
    summarize(stat=mean(stat)) %>%
    filter(external_gene_name != "") 
  
  # Add rank order for genes
  ranks <- deframe(dds_df)
  
  # conduct GSEA
  fgsea_df_hallmark <- fgsea(pathways=pathways.hallmark, stats=ranks) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-leadingEdge, -ES) 
  fgsea_df_reactome <- fgsea(pathways=pathways.reactome, stats=ranks) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-leadingEdge, -ES) 
  fgsea_df_go <- fgsea(pathways=pathways.go, stats=ranks) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-leadingEdge, -ES) 
  fgsea_df_immune <- fgsea(pathways=pathways.immune, stats=ranks) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-leadingEdge, -ES) 
  
  # create list
  fgseaList <- list(fgsea_df_hallmark,fgsea_df_reactome,fgsea_df_go,fgsea_df_immune)
  names(fgseaList) <- c("hallmark", "reactome", "go", "immune")
  
  return(fgseaList)
}

dds_list_LPS_gsea <- lapply(dds_list_LPS, function(dds_df) gsea(dds_df, pathways.hallmark,pathways.reactome,pathways.go,pathways.immune))
dds_list_VNS_LPS_gsea <- lapply(dds_list_VNS_LPS, function(dds_df) gsea(dds_df, pathways.hallmark,pathways.reactome,pathways.go,pathways.immune))
dds_list_VNS_Ctrl_gsea <- lapply(dds_list_VNS_Ctrl, function(dds_df) gsea(dds_df, pathways.hallmark,pathways.reactome,pathways.go,pathways.immune))
```

Plot values
```{r Plots}
## LPS vs Ctrl (standard treatment)
dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- lapply(dds_list_LPS_gsea, 
                                 function(x) lapply(x, 
                                                    function(y) y %>% 
                                                      as.data.frame() %>% 
                                                      filter(padj < 0.05) ))

## Subset to top 5 + and - enriched in Reactome
dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMax <- lapply(dds_list_LPS_gsea, 
                                 function(x) lapply(x, 
                                                    function(y) y %>% slice_max(n = 5, order_by = NES)))
dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMin <- lapply(dds_list_LPS_gsea, 
                                 function(x) lapply(x, 
                                                    function(y) y %>% slice_min(n = 5, order_by = NES)))

bindLists <- list(dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMax$cortex$reactome %>% as.data.frame(),
              dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMin$cortex$reactome %>% as.data.frame(),
              dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMax$hippocampus$reactome %>% as.data.frame(),
              dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMin$hippocampus$reactome %>% as.data.frame(),
              dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMax$spleen$reactome %>% as.data.frame(),
              dds_list_LPS_gsea_filt_slicedMin$spleen$reactome %>% as.data.frame())

df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(bindLists[[1]] %>% mutate(tissue = "cortex"),
                               bindLists[[2]] %>% mutate(tissue = "cortex"))
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               bindLists[[3]] %>% mutate(tissue = "hippocampus"))
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               bindLists[[4]] %>% mutate(tissue = "hippocampus"))
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               bindLists[[5]] %>% mutate(tissue = "spleen"))
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               bindLists[[6]] %>% mutate(tissue = "spleen"))

pathways <- unique(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt$pathway)

# Keep all pathways
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- dds_list_LPS_gsea$cortex$reactome %>% filter(pathway %in% pathways) %>% 
  mutate(tissue = "cortex")
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               dds_list_LPS_gsea$hippocampus$reactome %>% 
                                 filter(pathway %in% pathways) %>% 
                                 mutate(tissue = "hippocampus"))
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt <- rbind(df_list_LPS_gsea_filt,
                               dds_list_LPS_gsea$spleen$reactome %>% 
                                 filter(pathway %in% pathways) %>% 
                                 mutate(tissue = "spleen"))

## PLot
roughOrder <- unique((df_list_LPS_gsea_filt %>% filter(tissue == "cortex") %>% arrange(NES))$pathway)
df_list_LPS_gsea_filt_plot <- df_list_LPS_gsea_filt %>%
  mutate(pLabel = ifelse(padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(padj < 0.001, "**", "")),
         labelC = ifelse(NES > 0, "black", "white"),
         pathway = factor(pathway, levels = roughOrder))

df_list_LPS_gsea_filt_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=pathway, y = tissue, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +theme_classic() +
  theme(text =  element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0))+
  ylab("") + xlab("") +
  geom_text(aes(label = pLabel), color = df_list_LPS_gsea_filt_plot$labelC, size = 4)+
  coord_flip()+scale_fill_viridis_c(option="A")


## IDENTIFY VNS VS LPS pathways
# Filter VNS v LPS to padj < 0.05
dds_list_VNS_LPS_gsea_filt <- lapply(dds_list_VNS_LPS_gsea, function(x) lapply(x, function(y) y %>% filter(padj < 0.05)))
df_spleen_plot_path <- dds_list_VNS_LPS_gsea_filt$spleen$immune$pathway

# Get values compared to control!
df_spleen_plot <- dds_list_LPS_gsea$spleen$immune %>% 
  filter(pathway %in% df_spleen_plot_path) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = "LPS")
df_spleen_plot <- rbind(df_spleen_plot, 
                        dds_list_VNS_LPS_gsea$spleen$immune %>%
                          filter(pathway %in% df_spleen_plot_path) %>% 
                          mutate(treatment = "VNS"))

## PLot
df_spleen_plot <- df_spleen_plot %>% separate_wider_delim(pathway, "Cell ", names = c("cell", "path"),
                                                          too_few = "align_end")
df_spleen_plot$cell[5] = "CDC1"
df_spleen_plot$cell[6] = "M"
df_spleen_plot$cell[28] = "CDC1"
df_spleen_plot$cell[29] = "M"

df_spleen_plot <- df_spleen_plot %>% mutate(path_all = paste(cell,path,"_"))

roughOrder <- unique((df_spleen_plot %>% filter(treatment == "LPS") %>%
  arrange(as.character(path)) %>% arrange(NES) %>% arrange(as.character(cell)))$path_all)

df_spleen_plot <- df_spleen_plot %>%
  mutate(pLabel = ifelse(padj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(padj < 0.001, "**", "*")),
         labelC = ifelse(NES > 0, "black", "white"),
         path_all = factor(path_all, levels = roughOrder))

df_spleen_plot %>%
  mutate(NES = ifelse(NES > 3, 3, ifelse(NES < -2, -2, NES))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=path_all, y = treatment, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +theme_classic() +
  theme(text =  element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.line = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0))+
  ylab("") + xlab("") +
  geom_text(aes(label = pLabel), color = df_spleen_plot$labelC, size = 4)+
  coord_flip()+scale_fill_viridis_c(option="A")
```
